scope: Requirements arising from twelve full asset bodies and four freshly read embedding contexts; not a replacement denominator for the four ordinary lessons.

units.requirement: The two profiles and all six RNA scores are fictional, not Xue measurements.
Preserve A interferon/lipid/antigen-display 0.80/0.35/0.65 and B 0.45/0.85/0.55 with one invented 0-to-1 arbitrary-unit scoring method at 24 hours.
Equal-length tracks describe selected expression-program scores in identified macrophages, not cell fractions or a universal M1/M2 threshold.
Several programs coexist; the selected axes are not independent, freely adjustable or universally reversible controls.
Keep real source, stimulus, sampling time and cell-identification rules alongside expression results.
An antigen-display-associated RNA program does not establish functional antigen presentation.
Changed proportions across samples do not by themselves establish conversion of the same cells.
Human stimulation experiments support a spectrum of programs beyond the binary model, at their own study scope.
Macrophage state, developmental lineage, cell identification and tested function are separate claims; a program score establishes neither benefit nor treatment selection.
Removing one inhibitory ligand/contact changes one recognition input; it is not an automatic command to kill.
Loss of one HLA allele/contact is not absence of every class-I molecule or every inhibitory input.
Retain the other illustrated inhibitory contact and activating input in the matched two-target comparison.
A/B labels are illustrative contacts, not a measured HLA profile, a complete receptor map or numeric signal weights.
Activating and inhibitory receptor context, prior education and cytokine conditions affect the tested NK response.
The original missing-self experiment is mouse lymphoma evidence, not a guarantee for human tumors.
Test the actual NK-target pair with appropriate matched targets and controls; ligand identity or missing self alone does not establish the measured function.
Killing, degranulation, tumor access and patient benefit are distinct endpoints; native NK recognition does not establish a CAR-NK product benefit.
The large cutaway is one illustrative pathway-competent cell, not a specified patient or immune subtype.
Accessible DNA contacts cGAS; cGAS produces a distinct cGAMP messenger rather than converting the DNA into it.
cGAMP is a schematic cyclic messenger symbol, not an atomic structure or a molecular count.
This cytosolic example does not establish that all cGAS is exclusively cytosolic or that DNA presence measures activity.
Membrane-associated STING receives cGAMP through its cytosolic ligand-binding domain; DNA is not the depicted STING ligand.
STING spans the ER membrane and traffics toward Golgi membranes within the same cell, rather than being released as a cytokine.
The repeated messenger and STING glyphs show successive simplified positions, not increased abundance or measured stoichiometry.
Distinguish cytosol, nuclear enclosure and ER/Golgi luminal spaces and keep the ligand-binding face on the cytosolic side; simplified protein icons are not atomic anatomy.
The dashed nuclear connector denotes omitted signaling steps, not physical cargo movement of STING or cGAMP into the nucleus.
Trafficking alone does not prove a gene response; compatible downstream machinery and a measured output are separate requirements.
Host and cancer-cell panels carry equal illustrative weight; identify the responding cell, compartment, exposure history and measured outcome separately.
No universal short-stimulation benefit or chronic-stimulation harm rule, clinical efficacy, safety or tumor-specificity follows from this route.
Host antitumor sensing and tumor-cell progression findings retain their particular experimental model and association scope.
The reused DNA-sensing picture does not determine microbial versus host DNA origin.
Mislocated host DNA can engage this route without acquiring a new sequence; origin and sensor-accessible compartment are different variables.
A PAMP is a molecular feature rather than an entire pathogen; a DAMP is not automatically a tumor-specific antigen.
Sensing alone establishes neither infection nor a tumor-specific adaptive response, immunogenic cell death or patient benefit.
A cell-compartment example is not an all-sensors map; pathway dependency, source, adaptive target and functional outcome need separate evidence.
Historical PASS, independence, scientific fit, metrics, seals and pixel claims are attestations, not fresh approval.
Review-pending provenance can predate a later review without contradicting it; compare actual timestamps.
Check embedded public file hashes against both pins; private paths, candidate/package seals and unassigned commit assertions are not followed or treated as verified.
Classify scientific construction briefs and palette-only calls by their actual body content, retaining scientific requirements from edited/reference content.
Compare alt/caption strings to complete current parents without treating exact duplication as scientific verification.
Review-only reuse and the stated creation medium must not overwrite the literal raster generation receipts or establish creative authorship.
Native whole-theme review does not certify browser/mobile/contrast/accessibility, a production deployment, expert or learner acceptance.
Preserve prior artwork grades, source depth, ordinary lesson assessments, pending files and unassigned asset evidence; no extra credit from citation presence.
